Algimund.et: From Gothic 𐌰𐌻𐌷𐍃 (alhs, “holy temple”) + 𐌼𐌿𐌽𐌳𐍃 (munds, “power of mind, aspiration”) or Old High German alah (“holy temple”) + munt (“protector”), and ultimately from Proto-Germanic *alhs (“temple; sanctuary”) and *mundō (“protection, security”).

Algerd.et: From Gothic 𐌰𐌻𐌷𐍃 (alhs, “holy temple”) + 𐌲𐌰𐍂𐌳𐍃 (gards, “protector”) or Old High German alah + garda, and ultimately from Proto-Germanic *alhs and *gardaz; cognate to Lithuanian Algerdas, Algė, and German Algimund.
